*Do-the-job track · Job A of 3.*

Generate a stress-scenario set from real returns whose **joint tail** matches the
data — the input a risk engine needs.  Deliverable: a scenario matrix plus a tail
check against the alternatives.

---

## 1 · Fit RBIG on a Real Sub-Basket and Sample

```{python}
R = datasets.load_returns()
assets = ["JPM", "BAC", "XOM", "CVX"]
X = R[assets].to_numpy()
X = (X - X.mean(0)) / X.std(0)

rbig = AnnealedRBIG(n_layers=30, random_state=0).fit(X)
scen = rbig.sample(5000)
print(f"generated {scen.shape[0]} scenarios over {assets}")
```

## 2 · Tail Check vs Independent and Gaussian

```{python}
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
indep = np.column_stack([rng.permutation(X[:, k]) for k in range(X.shape[1])])
gmc = rng.multivariate_normal(X.mean(0), np.cov(X.T), size=5000)

print(f"{'pair':<10}{'real':>8}{'indep':>8}{'gaussMC':>9}{'RBIG':>8}")
print("-" * 43)
for i, j in [(0, 1), (2, 3), (0, 2)]:
    row = (cocrash_fraction(X[:, i], X[:, j]),
           cocrash_fraction(indep[:, i], indep[:, j]),
           cocrash_fraction(gmc[:, i], gmc[:, j]),
           cocrash_fraction(scen[:, i], scen[:, j]))
    print(f"{assets[i]}/{assets[j]:<6}" + "".join(f"{v:>8.0%}" for v in row))
```

RBIG tracks the real co-crash; independent resampling collapses it and the
Gaussian thins it.

```{python}
#| label: fig-jobA-scenarios
#| fig-cap: "JPM/BAC by generator. Real and RBIG fill the shaded joint lower-tail; independent resampling and Gaussian MC leave it nearly empty."
panels = [(X, COOL, "real"), (indep, CRASH, "independent"),
          (gmc, WARM, "Gaussian MC"),
          (scen, plotting.PALETTE["green"], "RBIG scenarios")]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(14, 3.8), sharex=True, sharey=True)
for ax, (data, col, name) in zip(axes, panels):
    ax.scatter(data[:, 0], data[:, 1], s=6, c=col, alpha=0.3, edgecolors="none")
    ax.axvspan(-8, np.quantile(X[:, 0], 0.1), color=INK, alpha=0.05)
    ax.axhspan(-8, np.quantile(X[:, 1], 0.1), color=INK, alpha=0.05)
    ax.set_title(f"{name}\nco-crash {cocrash_fraction(data[:,0], data[:,1]):.0%}",
                 fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlim(-6, 5); ax.set_ylim(-6, 5)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([]); despine(ax)
axes[0].set_ylabel("BAC (z)")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
